purpose: Make Dashboard V2 K-line first viewport readable while exposing baseline latest date, actor safe replay cutoff, latest stateless signals, and model differences.
ui_changes: Model freshness strip now shows each selected profile's replay date and latest signal date when the actor signal extends past safe replay.

Model difference cards are always visible and show replay cutoff, latest action/position, return, max drawdown, average position, NAV delta, position delta, mismatch count, and latest feature-difference context.
K-line, Position, and Rebased NAV panes are visually ordered before the expanded model-difference section.
Top status and freshness strips are constrained to viewport width and scroll horizontally instead of widening the whole page.
verification: PYTHONPATH=. qlib_venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard.py tests/test_dashboard_v2_data.py tests/test_dashboard_v2_checker.py tests/test_vercel_dashboard.py -q
